entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Misc. Bench No. - 32344 of 2019
Petitioner :- Mohammad Ahmad @ Mo Ahmad
Respondent :- State Of U.P.Thru.Prin.Secy.Food & Civil Supplies Lko.&Ors.

Counsel for Petitioner :- Sheikh Mohammad Ali Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Pankaj Kumar Jaiswal, J.
Hon'ble Alok Mathur, J.
Heard Sri Sheikh Mohammad Ali, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Gopal Kumar Srivastava, learned Standing Counsel for the State respondents.

Petitioner has filed an application for grant of license, vide annexure no. 1, under the provisions of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 and the regulations made thereunder but till date his application has not been decided by the authority concerned and, therefore, prayer has been made to decide the same expeditiously.

Learned Standing Counsel, has submitted that if the application of the petitioner is still pending,
then, the same will be decided in the light of the order of this Court dated 12.5.2017 passed in Writ Petition (M/B) No. 8293 of 2017.
Mohammad Ahmad @ Mo Ahmad vs State Of U.P.Thru.Prin.Secy.Food & ... on 25 November, 2019

entities.text: Mohammad Ahmad @ Mo Ahmad vs State Of U.P.Thru.Prin.Secy.Food
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 Considering the aforesaid, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the competent authority/respondent no. 3 (District Magistrate, Bahraich) is directed to consider and decide the application of the petitioner for registration of license, as the case may be, in accordance with law, in the light of the order dated 12.5.2017 passed by this Court in Writ Petition (M/B) No. 8293 of 2017,
within a period of two months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before him by a reasoned and speaking order.
With the aforesaid, writ petition is disposed of.

. 
(Alok Mathur, J.) (Pankaj Kumar Jaiswal, J.) Order Date :- 25.11.2019 Ajit/-
